proposed_aspects.description: Andhra biryani has a more intense spice profile with whole spices, while Malabar biryani uses a blend of ground and whole spices for a milder taste.

proposed_aspects.description: In Andhra, rice is cooked first separately before layering with meat, whereas in Malabar, both are often cooked simultaneously.
